name: Starmesh
install: go mod download && go build -o dist/starmesh ./hub/cmd/starmesh

terminals.name: dev-hub
terminals.description: Local Starmesh dev hub (loopback IPv6, --dev). Exposes the loopback JSON API on 127.0.0.1:7780 (GET /v1/status, /v1/invite). Connect spokes with: ./dist/starmesh spoke --name alice --home /tmp/alice --invite "$(curl -s http://127.0.0.1:7780/v1/invite | python3 -c 'import sys,json;print(json.load(sys.stdin)["invite"])')"
